seo.title: Marketplace
seo.description: Buy and sell with other Merx merchants. B2B feed with verified products, Stripe payments, transparent risk score on every listing.
seo.schemaDescription: B2B feed integrated into the Merx platform — verified vendors, Stripe payments, transparent risk score.

hero.title: Buy and sell with
hero.description: A B2B feed where Merx merchants buy and sell between each other. Verified products, Stripe payments, transparent risk score on every listing.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: From product to payment — three simple steps.

steps.title: List your products
steps.body: Your dashboard products appear automatically on the marketplace. Set the price, category, and availability.

steps.title: Other merchants buy
steps.body: Verified Merx merchants discover your products in the feed and place orders directly.

steps.title: Stripe handles payment
steps.body: Payment is processed securely via Stripe. You receive the amount minus the platform commission (2%).

features.title: Everything you need, in one place
features.description: Merx Marketplace is integrated directly into your dashboard. Zero extra setup — your products are already there.
items: Your products automatically listed from the dashboard
